The name Vincentina carries the meaning “Victor's Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Vincentina usually hope their child will grow to embody victor's conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
